natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, while two inherited findings indicate that reducing onboarding and signup friction improved completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation. This more directly addresses current deterioration than discounting, whose prior result included a 12% retention decline. Verification should confirm downstream qualified-revenue effects and guard against lower-quality activation before committing.
